statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: src/app/app.routes.ts, src/app/features/article/components/article-list.component.ts, src/app/features/article/pages/home/home.component.html, src/app/features/article/pages/home/home.component.ts, src/app/features/article/**/*.spec.ts. Do not edit forbidden paths: e2e/**, playwright.config.*, src/app/**/services/**, src/app/**/auth*, package.json, package-lock.json, src/environments/**.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.

review.notes: Approved: the base root route uniquely resolves to the production home component, and Angular global CSS authority is present. Scope text exactly matches the candidate; the tightened guard excludes E2E, test, generated, fixture, story, and build paths from rank one.
